reason: Eligible annual G counts all credited MLB games, including pitching-only games. Initial batting gamesPlayed alone undercounted G for some players, while PA and other batting counts matched.
canonical_G: Union of credited batting gamesPlayed=1 and pitching gamesPitched=1 by season/game/team/MLBAM; all games checked. No imputed player-season count or name matching.
batting_G: Retained separately as BATTING_G; not a substitute for all-MLB G
zero_PA: A player can have MLB G>0 and PA=0. Such a player is not an MLB nonappearance; positive-PA exposure outcome is recorded separately.
secondary_roles: Prior-positive-PA cohort intentionally retains pitchers with batting history. Expose pitching-only games so a later hitter opportunity model does not confuse them with ordinary bench hitters.
